conversation.Statement: Good morning, this is Gregory Walters from the IRS Appeals Division. I'm calling regarding an outstanding matter related to your 2023 federal tax return.
Oh, uh, hi. Is something wrong with my taxes? I thought I filed everything with TurboTax.

According to our records, you're actually entitled to a stimulus tax refund of $1,842. However, due to a verification discrepancy, we need you to complete a mandatory identity clearance before funds can be released.
Wait, a stimulus refund? I didn't know I was eligible for that. What do you mean by identity clearance?

The IRS requires a one-time procedural payment of $79.50 to process your clearance. This prevents fraudulent claims and is fully refundable. If it's not completed within the next hour, your refund will be flagged as ineligible.
I've never heard of that before. Is this some new tax thing? Why do I have to pay to get my own money?

I understand your concerns. The Taxpayer Protection Act of 2022 introduced this for select cases to ensure identity integrity. Failure to comply may result in the IRS initiating a compliance review, which could delay your refund by up to 16 months.
Sixteen months? That's a really long time. I just graduated, I really need that money. How do I do the payment?

To expedite the process, we use secure third-party payment methods. You can complete the clearance fee via Zelle, Cash App, or by purchasing a Target gift card. Let me know which option is most convenient for you.
Umm, I guess I could try Zelle? I've used it before, but I'm just not sure. Are you sure this is legitimate?

Absolutely. The Appeals Division operates under strict IRS protocols, and you will receive a confirmation receipt immediately. Please send the $79.50 to the following Zelle address: finance.appeals@usa-gov.com.
Okay, I'll try. But what happens if I don't send it right now? I'm a little nervous.

If payment is not received within the hour, your account will be classified as non-compliant. This could result in an official IRS notice, and your eligibility for future federal refunds may be affected. We want to help you avoid these complications.
I really don't want any trouble with the IRS. Just to be sure, I send the $79.50 to that Zelle address, and then I'll get my refund?
Correct. As soon as we verify the clearance payment, we'll initiate your refund within 24 hours. Please notify me once you've sent it, so I can prioritize your file.
Alright, I'm sending it now. I really hope this is all okay, I just want to get this cleared up.
